exercises.prompt: 选择最佳答案：若 $\cos\theta=\sqrt3/2$，θ 可能为哪项？A $2\pi/3$；B $5\pi/6$；C $5\pi/3$；D $11\pi/6$。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: 检查单位圆 x 坐标：A 为 -1/2，B 为 $-\sqrt3/2$，C 为 1/2，D 为 $\sqrt3/2$，仅 D 符合。

en.prompt: Choose the best answer. If $\cos\theta=\sqrt3/2$, which could be θ? A $2\pi/3$; B $5\pi/6$; C $5\pi/3$; D $11\pi/6$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: Check the unit-circle x-coordinates: A = -1/2, B = $-\sqrt3/2$, C = 1/2, D = $\sqrt3/2$. Only D matches.

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: 参照角 60°，正弦在第三、四象限为负，得 $180^\circ+60^\circ=240^\circ$ 与 $360^\circ-60^\circ=300^\circ$；负数选项不在范围内。

en.prompt: Choose exact solutions of $\sin\theta=-\sqrt3/2$, $0^\circ\le\theta<360^\circ$. A 60°,120°; B -60°,-120°; C 240°,300°; D -240°,-300°.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: Reference angle 60°; sine negative in III/IV gives $180^\circ+60^\circ=240^\circ$, $360^\circ-60^\circ=300^\circ$. Negative choices do not satisfy the domain.

exercises.prompt: 若 $\cot\theta=1.4$，哪个是 θ 的近似弧度值？A 0.620；B 0.951；C 1.052；D 0.018。

en.prompt: If $\cot\theta=1.4$, which is one approximate measure in radians? A 0.620; B 0.951; C 1.052; D 0.018.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: Tangent = 1/1.4 = 5/7. In radian mode $\theta=\arctan(5/7)=0.620249\ldots$, which rounds to 0.620.

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: 逆时针 90° 将 $(x,y)\to(-y,x)$，代入 P 得第三象限 $Q=(-\sqrt7/4,-3/4)$，符合原图。

en.prompt: $P=(-3/4,\sqrt7/4)$ is on the unit circle. What is Q after a 90° counterclockwise rotation? A $(\sqrt7/4,-3/4)$; B $(-\sqrt7/4,-3/4)$; C $(3/4,\sqrt7/4)$; D $(-3/4,-\sqrt7/4)$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: A 90° CCW rotation sends $(x,y)\to(-y,x)$. Substituting P gives $Q=(-\sqrt7/4,-3/4)$ in III, matching the original diagram.

en.prompt: How many solutions does $\sin\theta(\sin\theta+1)=0$ have for $-180^\circ<\theta<360^\circ$? A 3; B 4; C 5; D 6.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: Sine = 0 gives 0°,180°; -180° and 360° are excluded. Sine = -1 gives -90°,270°. Four distinct solutions, so B.

exercises.prompt: 车辆轮胎直径 75 厘米，边缘标一点。(a) 时速 110 千米/时，求该点每秒转角的度数与弧度，保留一位小数；(b) 直径改为 66 厘米时求弧度值，讨论直径是否影响轮胎寿命。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: (b) 半径 0.33 米，$\theta=(275/9)/0.33=2500/27=92.592593\ldots$ 弧度。小轮胎同路程转数与胎面弯曲次数更多，可能影响磨损；材料、载荷及使用也影响寿命，不能仅由直径定寿命。

exercises.answer: (a) 每秒 $4668.5^\circ$、81.5 弧度；(b) 每秒 92.6 弧度；小轮胎转数更多。

en.prompt: A vehicle has tires 75 cm in diameter, with a point marked on the edge. (a) If it travels at 110 km/h, find the angle through which the point turns each second, in degrees and radians to the nearest tenth. (b) Find the radian answer for 66 cm diameter; does diameter affect tire life? Explain.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: Assuming rolling without slipping, the one-second distance is $s=110000/3600=275/9$ m. Radius = 0.375 m. Thus $\theta=s/r=2200/27=81.481481\ldots$ rad, or $\theta(180/\pi)=4668.544997\ldots^\circ$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (b) Radius = 0.33 m: $\theta=(275/9)/0.33=2500/27=92.592593\ldots$ rad. A smaller tire makes more rotations per distance and more flexing cycles per tread element, which may affect wear; material, load and use also affect life, so diameter alone does not determine it.

en.answer: (a) $4668.5^\circ$, 81.5 rad per second; (b) 92.6 rad per second; smaller tires rotate more.

exercises.prompt: (a) 写出原点为圆心、半径 1 的圆方程；(b) 求所有缺失坐标并作图：(i) $(2\sqrt3/5,y)$；(ii) $(x,\sqrt7/4)$，x < 0；(c) 已知终边交单位圆点的 y 坐标，如何用单位圆方程求 $\cos\theta$？

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: (c) $\cos\theta=x=\pm\sqrt{1-y^2}$；需象限或 x 符号选正负，除非 |y| = 1 时 x = 0，并须检查 $|y|\le1$。

en.prompt: (a) Give the equation for a circle centred at the origin with radius 1. (b) Find every missing coordinate and draw diagrams: (i) $(2\sqrt3/5,y)$; (ii) $(x,\sqrt7/4)$, x < 0. (c) Explain how to use the unit-circle equation to find $\cos\theta$ from the y-coordinate of a terminal-arm intersection.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (a) Pythagoras gives $x^2+y^2=1$. (b-i) $y^2=1-12/25=13/25$, so $y=\pm\sqrt{13}/5$, in I and IV. (b-ii) $x^2=1-7/16=9/16$; x < 0 selects $x=-3/4$, in II.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (c) $\cos\theta=x=\pm\sqrt{1-y^2}$. A quadrant or sign of x is needed to choose the sign, unless |y| = 1, when x = 0. Check that $|y|\le1$.

exercises.prompt: 某角余弦为负，已找到第三象限的一个解。(a) 如何找 0 与 2π 间另一个解？(b) 如何写通解？

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: 设第三象限解为 β，$\pi<\beta<3\pi/2$。关于 x 轴反射，第二象限角为 $2\pi-\beta$，两者 x 坐标相同。各基本角加 $2\pi n$ 即得全部实数解。

en.prompt: Cosine of an angle is negative and one solution is in III. (a) Explain how to find the other solution between 0 and 2π. (b) Describe the general solution.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: Let the III solution be β, with $\pi<\beta<3\pi/2$. Reflect across the x-axis: the II angle is $2\pi-\beta$. Both have the same x-coordinate. Add $2\pi n$ to each base angle to obtain all real solutions.

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: $\cos\theta=-\sqrt2/2$，参照角 π/4，第二、三象限得 $3\pi/4,5\pi/4$，加整周 $2\pi n$；代入为 $2(-\sqrt2/2)+\sqrt2=0$。

steps.title: Work
steps.body: $\cos\theta=-\sqrt2/2$. Reference angle π/4 in II/III gives $3\pi/4,5\pi/4$. Add full turns $2\pi n$. Substitution gives $2(-\sqrt2/2)+\sqrt2=0$.

exercises.prompt: 解释 3° 与 3 弧度的区别。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: $3^\circ=3\pi/180=\pi/60\approx0.05236$ 弧度，是第一象限小角。3 弧度为 $(540/\pi)^\circ\approx171.9^\circ$，是接近半周的第二象限角；数值相同不表示单位相同。

en.prompt: Explain the difference between an angle of 3° and one of 3 radians.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: $3^\circ=3\pi/180=\pi/60\approx0.05236$ rad, a small I angle. Three radians equals $(540/\pi)^\circ\approx171.9^\circ$, a II angle close to a half turn. The numeric measure alone does not specify the unit.

exercises.prompt: 标准位置角为 -500°。(a) 求象限；(b) 求参照角；(c) 求六个三角比，保留一位小数。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: (a,b) $-500^\circ+720^\circ=220^\circ$，第三象限；参照角 $220^\circ-180^\circ=40^\circ$。正弦余弦负，正切正。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: (c) 正弦 $-\sin40^\circ\approx-0.642788$，余弦 $-\cos40^\circ\approx-0.766044$，正切 $\tan40^\circ\approx0.839100$；在取近似前取倒数得余割 -1.555724、正割 -1.305407、余切 1.191754。

en.prompt: An angle in standard position is -500°. (a) Identify its quadrant. (b) Find the reference angle. (c) Find all six ratios to one decimal place.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (a,b) $-500^\circ+720^\circ=220^\circ$, in III; reference = $220^\circ-180^\circ=40^\circ$. Thus sine and cosine are negative; tangent is positive.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (c) Sine = $-\sin40^\circ\approx-0.642788$, cosine = $-\cos40^\circ\approx-0.766044$, tangent = $\tan40^\circ\approx0.839100$. Reciprocals before rounding give csc ≈ -1.555724, sec ≈ -1.305407, cot ≈ 1.191754.

exercises.prompt: 各给一个正、负同终边角，再写全部同终边角通式：(a) $13\pi/4$；(b) -575°。

en.prompt: Give one positive and one negative coterminal angle, then a general expression for all coterminal angles: (a) $13\pi/4$; (b) -575°.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (a) Subtract $2\pi$ to get $5\pi/4>0$; subtract another $2\pi$ to get $-3\pi/4<0$. All: $13\pi/4+2\pi n$. (b) Add 720° to get 145°; add 360° to get -215°. All: $-575^\circ+360^\circ n$, n integer.

exercises.prompt: 图示 A 至 E 道路的弯曲段为圆弧。求总长，保留十分之一千米。AB 半径 1.3 千米、圆心角 1.48 弧度；BC = 1.9 千米；CD 半径 1 千米、圆心角 79°；DE = 2.5 千米。

en.prompt: The road from A to E is shown; curves are circular arcs. Determine its length to the nearest tenth of a kilometre. AB has radius 1.3 km and central angle 1.48 rad; BC = 1.9 km; CD has radius 1 km and central angle 79°; DE = 2.5 km.

exercises.prompt: 画任意三角形 ABC，A 为原点，AB 在 +x 轴上，C 在第一象限。证明面积为 $\frac12bc\sin A$ 或 $\frac12ac\sin B$。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: 按通常记号 a = BC、b = CA、c = AB。从 C 向 AB 所在直线作垂线，高为 h；由 CA 得 $h=b\sin A$，故面积 $\frac12ch=\frac12bc\sin A$。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: 由 CB 得 $h=a\sin B$。若 B 为钝角，直角三角形锐角为 180°−B，其正弦仍为 sin B，故两种情形面积均为 $\frac12ch=\frac12ac\sin B$。

en.prompt: Draw any triangle ABC with A at the origin, AB along +x and C in I. Show its area is $\frac12bc\sin A$ or $\frac12ac\sin B$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: Use conventional side labels a = BC, b = CA, c = AB. Drop the perpendicular from C to line AB with height h. From CA, $h=b\sin A$, so area = $\frac12ch=\frac12bc\sin A$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: From CB, $h=a\sin B$. If B is obtuse, the right-triangle acute angle is 180°−B and its sine still equals sin B. Thus area = $\frac12ch=\frac12ac\sin B$ in either case.

exercises.prompt: 尽量给精确解，否则保留百分之一：(a) $3\tan^2\theta-\tan\theta-4=0$，$-\pi<\theta<2\pi$；(b) $\sin^2\theta+\sin\theta-1=0$，$0\le\theta<2\pi$；(c) $\tan^2\theta=4\tan\theta$，$\theta\in[0,2\pi]$。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: (a) 分解 $(3\tan\theta-4)(\tan\theta+1)=0$。正切 4/3 时令 $\alpha=\arctan(4/3)=0.927295\ldots$，范围内为 $\alpha-\pi,\alpha,\alpha+\pi\approx-2.21,0.93,4.07$。正切 -1 时得精确 $-\pi/4,3\pi/4,7\pi/4$。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: (b) 令 u 为正弦，$u=(-1\pm\sqrt5)/2$；排除小于 -1 的值，令 $v=(\sqrt5-1)/2$，得 $\theta=\arcsin v,\pi-\arcsin v\approx0.67,2.48$。

steps.title: 推导
steps.body: (c) 分解 $\tan\theta(\tan\theta-4)=0$。正切 0 得 $0,\pi,2\pi$，含两端点；正切 4 得 $\arctan4,\pi+\arctan4\approx1.33,4.47$。未除以正切，零解全部保留。

en.prompt: Solve exactly where possible, otherwise to the nearest hundredth. (a) $3\tan^2\theta-\tan\theta-4=0$, $-\pi<\theta<2\pi$; (b) $\sin^2\theta+\sin\theta-1=0$, $0\le\theta<2\pi$; (c) $\tan^2\theta=4\tan\theta$, $\theta\in[0,2\pi]$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (a) Factor $(3\tan\theta-4)(\tan\theta+1)=0$. For tan = 4/3 let $\alpha=\arctan(4/3)=0.927295\ldots$; the domain gives $\alpha-\pi,\alpha,\alpha+\pi\approx-2.21,0.93,4.07$. Tan = -1 gives exact $-\pi/4,3\pi/4,7\pi/4$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (b) With u = sine, $u=(-1\pm\sqrt5)/2$. Reject the value below -1; let $v=(\sqrt5-1)/2$. Then $\theta=\arcsin v,\pi-\arcsin v\approx0.67,2.48$.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: (c) Factor $\tan\theta(\tan\theta-4)=0$. Tan = 0 gives $0,\pi,2\pi$, including both endpoints. Tan = 4 gives $\arctan4,\pi+\arctan4\approx1.33,4.47$. No division by tangent is used, so zeros are retained.

exercises.prompt: Jack 骑在 West Edmonton Mall 旋转木马上，距中心 8 米。旋转 210° 后停下让哭泣小孩下马。Jack 走过多长弧线？给精确值及保留百分之一米的近似值。

en.prompt: Jack rides a carousel horse 8 m from the centre at West Edmonton Mall. It turns 210° before stopping to let a crying child off. How far did Jack travel? Give exact and approximate answers to the nearest hundredth of a metre.

steps.title: Work
steps.body: Convert $210^\circ=210\pi/180=7\pi/6$ rad. Arc length $s=r\theta=8(7\pi/6)=28\pi/3$ m. Numerically this is $29.321531\ldots\approx29.32$ m.
